title: Bun Runtime & Toolchain
description: Bun reference covering the runtime, package manager, lockfile, workspaces, scripts, Bun.serve, files, SQL, testing, bundling, Node compatibility, performance, deployment, and security.

subtopics.title: Run, Install & Execute
subtopics.description: Bun executes JS/TS/JSX, package scripts, and binaries from one CLI. Commit bun.lock and use frozen installs in CI.

codeBlocks.code:
bun init
bun add hono
bun add -d typescript @types/bun
bun run dev

subtopics.title: Workspaces, Catalogs & bunfig
subtopics.description: Use workspaces for one dependency graph, filtered commands for targeted packages, and bunfig.toml for repository-level Bun behavior.

callouts.title: One Toolchain per Repository
callouts.text: Avoid casually mixing npm, pnpm, Yarn, and Bun lockfiles. Pick an owner, pin its version, and make CI enforce it.

subtopics.title: Bun.serve, Routing & WebSockets
subtopics.description: Bun.serve provides Fetch-style request/response handling. Validate inputs, propagate aborts, and keep per-request work bounded.

subtopics.title: Files, Environment, SQLite & SQL
subtopics.description: Bun.file is lazy and Blob-compatible; environment variables are strings; built-in database APIs still require transactions, pooling, migrations, and parameterization.

callouts.title: Built-In Does Not Mean Unbounded
callouts.text: Set request/body/time limits, bound database concurrency, use transactions, and keep migrations outside replica startup races.

subtopics.title: bun:test, Mocks & CI
subtopics.description: Bun's Jest-style runner supports TypeScript, hooks, mocks, snapshots, watch mode, coverage, and CI reporters.

callouts.title: Compatibility Is Not Identity
callouts.text: Jest-compatible does not guarantee every matcher, mock edge case, environment, or plugin behaves identically. Run migration suites before switching CI.

subtopics.title: Bundler Targets & Node Compatibility
subtopics.description: Choose browser, bun, or node targets intentionally; externalize runtime dependencies when appropriate; test Node APIs and native addons used by the application.

codeBlocks.code:
bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir ./dist --target bun --sourcemap
bun build ./src/browser.ts --outdir ./public --target browser --minify

subtopics.title: Containers, Signals & Shutdown
subtopics.description: Pin the Bun image/version, use multi-stage builds, run as non-root, expose health checks, and stop accepting work before closing resources.

codeBlocks.code:
FROM oven/bun:1 AS install
WORKDIR /app
COPY package.json bun.lock ./
RUN bun install --frozen-lockfile --production
COPY . .
USER bun
CMD ["bun", "run", "src/index.ts"]

subtopics.title: Compiled Executables, Workers & Subprocesses
subtopics.description: Bun can compile applications into standalone executables and provides Worker and subprocess APIs. Define platform targets, embedded assets, child lifetime, signals, streams, and resource limits explicitly.

callouts.title: Compilation Does Not Remove Compatibility Testing
callouts.text: Test the emitted executable on every target OS/architecture and verify dynamic libraries, native addons, filesystem assets, environment assumptions, updates, and vulnerability response.

subtopics.title: Security & Operations Checklist
subtopics.description: Treat runtime compatibility, dependencies, limits, logs, metrics, and shutdown as explicit deployment contracts.

callouts.title: Production Checklist
callouts.text: Pin Bun, commit bun.lock, use frozen installs, test Node compatibility, validate input, parameterize SQL, redact secrets, bound concurrency, configure timeouts, and verify graceful shutdown.
